defaultIsolationEvidence.source: Target-CI distributable lanes run inside a Linux network namespace with only loopback enabled, then irreversibly drop privilege with no_new_privs and empty capability sets before tests start. The kernel therefore denies cross-VM IP egress and prevents re-entering the parent namespace independently of the Node, native, or shell API used. Each file still runs in a fresh process, one file at a time. The preload guard adds before-I/O diagnostics for its recognized Node and child-process surfaces, including non-loopback Bash /dev/tcp and /dev/udp redirections and explicit privilege-escape commands; exact temporary executable fixtures remain explicitly declared.

sharedResources.reason: Exercises the fixed official HTTPS origin through a test-owned loopback CONNECT proxy. The distributable URL guard rejects the official authority before the proxy contract can run; retain this exact test in the existing serial lane without excluding it or changing its assertions.

sharedResourceEvidence.source: test/f320-quota-proxy.test.js and test/helpers/quota-proxy-fixture.js: official chatgpt.com URL and CONNECT authority, but a generated test certificate, two loopback servers, synthetic credentials and a DNS stub that blocks direct official network access; no real provider or account is exercised.
